licenseAndAttribution: Public passenger railway information published by Southern Railway / Indian Railways. Curated GTFS data mirrored under ODbL / PDDL.
limitationsAndCaveats: Raw GTFS snapshot (9 files: agency, calendar, calendar_dates, feed_info, pathways, routes, stops, stop_times, trips) imported into data/suburban_rail/imported/ and preprocessed under data/suburban_rail/derived/ with SHA-256 verification and strict routing isolation (readyForJourneyRouting: false).

CUMTA GTFS models services as daily route patterns rather than complete per-train timetable trips. Specific train schedules are governed by Southern Railway suburban timetable sheets (40xxx/43xxx EMU series).

MRTS Phase 2 extension from Velachery to St. Thomas Mount received CCRS certification in March 2026 with new stations Puzhuthivakkam and Adambakkam; commercial timetable synchronization is in progress.

Accessibility: Step-free access flags on select junction stations reflect platform lift installations under Divyangjan schemes, but continuous barrier-free platform-to-platform connectivity is not universally verified.
Express and Superfast trains operating along these same physical tracks are segregated under the separate express_rail data domain to maintain strict suburban ticket validity boundaries.
